verdict.rationale: First-party developer docs describe a REST API for card and bank statements, receipt downloads, transaction reconciliation, and linking or downloading receipts and invoices on transactions. Expenses can be classified by category, cost center, and supplier. Authentication is OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials, and each credential is limited to the scopes granted to it, with an API reference and playground. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API, and a publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec (common paths returned 404).
